tiers.text: Your pawns are close to the end of the board. How close?
A pawn that reaches the last row becomes a queen.
Your a-pawn is the piece to move.
a7 is one step from becoming a queen. Black has to rush the king over to stop it.
Black's king is guarding a8. Can you chase it away?
Give a check that makes the king move.
Your knight is the piece to use.
Nd6+ checks the king and attacks the rook. The king has to move, and then it can't stop your pawn.
The way is clear. What should your pawn become?
Play a8=Q. Your pawn becomes a queen!
